arguments.recommended_next_step: Investigate the root cause of the failing jobs, prioritize and fix the backlog, and ensure that any necessary restarts are approved by the principal. Additionally, monitor the pgbouncer service status and read its logs to understand the connection pool exhaustion issue.
arguments.summary: The failed-jobs backlog in the jobs database has been growing, with 1,388 failed jobs and 47 malformed rows as of now. There is an alert indicating that the prod pgbouncer connection pool was exhausted, which had a worker throughput of 0. Restarting pgbouncer in prod cleared the pool immediately. The next steps will be to investigate the root cause of the failures, get the backlog moving again, and export the failed_jobs table for the postmortem. Monitoring the pgbouncer service status and reading its logs will provide further insights into the connection pool exhaustion issue.
